title: Alethig Media OS | Create and publish your business content with AI
metaDescription: Alethig Media OS creates on-brand posts, carousels and reel scripts for your business, schedules them and publishes to Instagram and Facebook. Includes 12 AI marketing advisors and a CRM. From $37/month.
heading: A Month of Marketing, Ready in One Afternoon.
paragraph: Alethig Media OS creates on-brand posts, carousels and reel scripts for your business, lets you approve them, and publishes them automatically to Instagram and Facebook. It's the same platform we use with our clients, now ready for you to use yourself.
heroNote: 14-day free trial when we open. No contracts.
problemHeading: You know you should post. The problem is time.
problemText: Coming up with ideas, designing, writing captions and remembering to post every day takes hours you need for your business. Alethig Media OS does the heavy lifting: you review, tweak whatever you want and approve.
featuresHeading: Everything you need for social media, in one place.

features.title: On-brand posts and carousels
features.desc: Captions and images with your colors, logo and tone, ready for Instagram and Facebook.

features.title: Reels made easy
features.desc: Scene-by-scene scripts to film, plus reels with music made from your carousels.

features.title: 12 AI marketing advisors
features.desc: Ask them like a team: strategy, SWOT analysis, hooks, ads, local SEO, sales and results.

features.title: Approval and auto-publishing
features.desc: Nothing goes out without your OK. Pick the day and time and it posts itself. If something fails, we email you.

features.title: Lead CRM
features.desc: Keep track of your leads inside the same app.

features.title: English and Spanish
features.desc: Create content in one language or both, with no manual translation.

steps.title: Tell us about your business
steps.desc: Your services, your city, your logo and colors. You do it once.

steps.title: Ask for your content
steps.desc: Describe what you want to post, or let the app plan your week.

steps.title: Review and approve
steps.desc: Change anything you want. Nothing is published without your approval.

steps.title: It posts itself
steps.desc: Connect Instagram and Facebook, pick the time, and you're done.

plansIntro: Every plan includes every feature. The difference is how much content you create each month.

plansFootnote: Prices in US dollars. 1 credit = 1 image; each carousel slide uses 1 credit. Unused credits don't roll over.
agencyLinkLabel: Rather have our team create the content for you? See Managed Content →

faq.q: Do I need design or marketing experience?
faq.a: No. The app creates content from your business information and you just review and approve. If you have questions, the AI advisors walk you through it.

faq.q: Will anything be posted without me seeing it?
faq.a: Never. Every piece needs approval from someone on your team before it's published.

faq.q: Which platforms does it publish to?
faq.a: Instagram and Facebook, through your own connected account. You can disconnect it anytime.

faq.q: How does the free trial work?
faq.a: You get 14 days to try the app with a smaller usage limit. If you choose a plan, all your content and settings stay.
Yes, anytime. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period you already paid for. No contracts.
We open in January 2027. Reserve your spot and we'll let you know first.

finalText: Reserve your spot and be one of the first to use Alethig Media OS when we open in January.
